objectives.title: Find details in a short text

lessons.explanation: These verbs change a stem e to ie in stressed present forms; nosotros/vosotros keep e. Pensar + infinitive expresses an intention, querer + infinitive a desire, and preferir a preference.
commonMistakes: Nosotros pensamos, queremos and preferimos keep e. The last two letters alone cannot predict these forms.
lessons.provenance: Original Palabra lesson; grammatical rules checked against RAE references. Author review, 2026-10-30; no independent teacher audit.

lessons.explanation: Use este/esta/estos/estas near the speaker, ese/esa/esos/esas for the indicated middle distance, and aquel/aquella/aquellos/aquellas farther away. Agree with the noun. The context must establish distance.
commonMistakes: Demonstrative adjectives have no written accents. Do not confuse esta camisa with está (the verb).

stimuli.SpanishText: En la tienda quiero comprar una camisa. Esta camisa aquí es azul y aquella camisa allá es verde. Mi hermana prefiere la verde, pero yo prefiero la azul. Pensamos comprar zapatos también. Estos zapatos cerca de mí son cómodos. Esos zapatos cerca de mi hermana son más caros. Nosotros queremos pagar ahora, pero mi hermana quiere mirar una chaqueta roja. No pensamos comprarla hoy porque no tenemos suficiente dinero.
stimuli.provenance: Original fictional passage, authored for Palabra. Not a textbook reading.

culture.text: A regional pronoun such as vos belongs to a wider system of verb forms. Do not mix it automatically with tú endings; learn a variety in context.
